API for data structures

H2 statistics class

class h2py.stats.H2stats(data, pops)

Class for holding expected H2 and heterozygosity statistics computed with moments.Demes.LD.

Parameters:

  • data (list) – Arrays of expected H2 statistics. The last element should contain one-locus statistics (H, H_ij).

  • pops (list) – Population labels

LD statistics class

class h2py.stats.LDstats(data, num_pops=None, pop_ids=None)

An extension of the moments LDstats class, for handling Hill-Robertson statistics alongside H2 in inference.
